title: Inzwi Rakanyarara reMupata
intro: Dzokera shure munguva iyoyo kune vanhu vane simba vakambogamuchira chishamiso chipenyu semuedzo. Kuzvikudza nekusindimara kwakasimbisa mugumo wavo. Unogona here kutevedzera nyaya yacho woona zvakaitika panguva iyi yekuchinja kukuru?
clues: Ndakatumirwa semuedzo waMwari kuvanhu vane simba vanozivikanwa nesimba ravo uye kusateerera kwavo.
Ndakanga ndiri chishamiso chinoshamisa—vanhu vakaita seni vakanga vasati vamboonekwa pakati pavo.
Ndakagovana mvura yekunwa kubva mutsime nevanhu vangu pamazuva akasiyana.
Vakanyeverwa kuti chero chii zvacho chingandikuvadza chaizounza chirango chinokurumidza.
Vane ushingi hwakanyanya pakati pavo havana kuteerera yambiro yacho ndokundiruma chiuno.
Mushure mekufa kwangu, kuchema kamwe chete kwakabva kumusoro kwakaparadza vanhu vangu vese.
verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
